scope: General framework for reconstructing historical registered-property states; not a property-specific historical title determination.

verified_propositions.claim: The register is conclusive evidence of the title of the owner as appearing on the register, subject to the statutory exceptions and rectification jurisdiction.
The statutory description of registered land by reference to registry maps is not, except as provided by the Act, conclusive as to boundaries or extent.
verified_propositions.source: Registration of Title Act 1964, section 85 as substituted by Registration of Deeds and Title Act 2006

verified_propositions.claim: Tailte Éireann maintains the Land Registry folios and maps as a public record and provides copy/search services; filed instruments may provide additional evidence of the documents underlying a completed dealing, subject to access rules.
verified_propositions.source: Tailte Éireann Search and Copy Services

verified_propositions.claim: Registry of Deeds records can establish that documents were executed and registered, but the Registry of Deeds does not retain the deeds themselves; determining their effect may require examination of the deeds.
verified_propositions.source: Tailte Éireann Search and Copy Services

historical_answer_boundary.direct_record: A contemporaneous or officially identifiable historical register entry is direct evidence of the registered state within its scope.
historical_answer_boundary.reconstruction: Where the exact target-date record is unavailable, a historical state may sometimes be reconstructed from sequential official records and documents, but the answer must label the reconstruction rather than presenting it as a direct record.
historical_answer_boundary.unknown: If the evidence cannot establish the state at the target date, the answer must remain unresolved.

official_sources: Tailte Éireann Search and Copy Services
property_specific_gate: Historical property conclusions require property identity, relevant date, authoritative records and a documented evidence chain.
